summary: Macerich Co. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into forward sale agreements via underwritten public offering of 14 million common shares (with greenshoe for up to 2.1 million additional shares). Initial forward price of $23.12325 per share; company will not receive initial proceeds but expects to physically settle by June 16, 2027, receiving cash subject to adjustments. Forward sellers borrowed shares from third parties; proceeds deferred. Underwriters include Goldman Sachs, Deutsche Bank, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, BMO, TD Securities, Scotia. Watch for share dilution and potential early settlement or cash/net-share settlement as alternative.
